traceability.notes: All specified requirements for story 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS are implemented and verified. `normalizeCommentLine` now strips backtick-wrapped content using a centralized filter, preserves character boundaries by replacing with equal-length spaces, and continues to detect real @story/@req/@supports annotations outside inline code. Dedicated tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format-internal.test.ts cover ignoring backtick-wrapped annotation keywords, typical documentation patterns (e.g., `@story` + `@req`, 'using `@supports`'), correct detection of real annotations in mixed lines, multiple backtick segments, and unchanged behavior for lines without backticks. The entire Jest suite passes, providing regression assurance. JSDoc on `normalizeCommentLine` documents the inline-code filtering behavior. Together, this evidence supports a PASSED assessment for this story.
